source.scope: One local physical AC1024 witness. The original importing adapter/data must pass its same-import LayerStates source-graph preflight before, during, and after staged output.

implementation.description: The test-only adapter projects the selected source edges through real dxfRW TABLES and OBJECTS staging. It registers the source NOD handle for the generated root and selects ACAD_SCALELIST; the root record is regenerated, not a copy of the complete source NOD metadata. The SCALELIST dictionary and all 32 SCALE objects are copied from the same imported data.

observations: The actual staged output has one generated NOD 0xC with a selected ACAD_SCALELIST soft-owner entry targeting mapped dictionary 0xA126, and that dictionary has one output ledger identity with owner 0xC.

The staged SCALELIST is compared with its source dictionary using nonidentity handle mapping, including its ordered entries and common fields; each of the 32 mapped targets has one SCALE ledger identity and the mapped dictionary owner.

Each staged SCALE body is decoded and checked against its selected source name, flag, units, unit flag, mapped parent and reactor. The prior APPID, companion EED, nested dictionary and XRECORD-to-SCALE controls remain in the same writer staging test.

For each ASCII and Binary encoding, twelve distinct injected faults are refused while a pre-existing destination sentinel is preserved; after each fault the corrected data is written using the same codec. The five added faults change the NOD target, a SCALELIST member target, the SCALELIST owner, a nonselected SCALE's units, and duplicate a SCALE identity.
limits: This is a selected source-projected staging control using a test adapter. It does not preserve or qualify the complete source NOD, unrelated roots, SUN, or a complete production fileExport graph.
The generated root entry's DXF soft-owner role is observed in this output; it does not by itself establish correspondence with every source DWG wire role.
The staging decoder is from the same implementation. Independent readback, native LayerStates semantics, full-source strict output and broader format support remain unqualified.
